household.title: Name your household
household.body: This is the shared space for your money. You can rename it later.
household.label: Household name

region.title: Money and time
region.body: The time zone decides when a day and a month start for both of you.

accounts.title: Add your accounts
accounts.body: Tap the accounts you use. You can add more later.
accounts.partnerLater: Accounts can be given to your partner once they join.

invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.body: They get an email with a link to join this household. It works for 7 days.
invite.full: Your household already has all its members.

create.title: Start your household
create.body: You are not in a household right now. Start a new one, or join your partner’s with the link from their invitation.

join.title: Join with an invitation
join.body: Paste the link from the invitation email, or just its code.
join.label: Invitation link or code
join.invalid: That is not an invitation link. Copy the whole link from the email.
